o.text:
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish ایچره (ičrä), ultimately from Proto-Turkic *ič.
Cognates
* Chuvash ӑшри (ăšri, “interior”),
* Old Turkic 𐰃𐰲𐰼𐰀 (ičr²a, “inside”),
* Ottoman Turkish ایچره,
* Turkish içre
